description: Create many QR codes at once from a list — e.g. 'make codes for these 20 product URLs in our brand colors'. All codes share the design/options you pass (colors, pattern, frame, dynamic, template). Returns the created codes and any per-item errors. Max 100 per call.

dynamic.description: Make all of them editable + tracked; can't be switched after creation. Free up to a per-plan limit, not paid-only — a large batch can exceed it partway through, which shows up as per-item errors, not a whole-batch failure.

error_correction.description: QR error correction level (L, M, Q, H). Leave unset: it is chosen automatically (H with a logo, Q otherwise).

eye_color.description: Hex color for the corner eyes, only if different from `primary_color`.

frame.description: Frame slug, as in create_qr_code. Set `text` without a `frame` and one that can show it is chosen automatically.

frame_color.description: Hex color for the frame, only if different from `primary_color`.

has_border.description: Draw a border around the code.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key to make retries safe: if a previous call used the same key (same workspace), the earlier result is replayed instead of creating duplicate codes. Use a fresh key per distinct batch.

items.description: URLs to encode. Each item is a URL string, or an object {url, display_name}.

logo_url.description: URL of a logo image to place in the center.

primary_color.description: Hex color for the QR pattern, e.g. #111111. Eyes and frame follow it automatically (rules as in create_qr_code).

tags.description: Labels to attach (created if new) so you can find these later — list_qr_codes and list_short_links search by tag.

template.description: Workspace template id to apply to all.

text.description: Caption text; a frame that can show it is chosen automatically.

text_secondary.description: Secondary caption line, where the frame supports it.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: create_qr_codes_bulk

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.
